reviews.reason: Gathering and eating already support obtaining and consuming these non-toxic foods, but neither performs preparation or produces a traceable prepared meal. Develop a minimal hand-mashed root or berry preparation without requiring fire, a vessel or invented equipment. Its benefit is portable, portionable prepared food, not extra nutrition, detoxification or automatic happiness.
reviews.experienceReview: Preparation alone earns no wellbeing. Actual substantial consumption is plausibly enjoyable and must use the existing meal-experience mechanism, not a second preparation reward. Bind successful eat consumption by the actual eater to meal-experience: qualify only at the existing substantialNutrition threshold of 8 realized nutrition in the mealWindow of 10; derive quality, monotony and applicability from actual ingredient intake and current personal food history. Keep its existing executable pleasure amount, cap, duration and repetition/cooldown contract unchanged after validating it in the handoff; the supplied successful root meal demonstrates that this rule already operates. Prepared labels do not add diversity, reset repetition or create a maintained source. Existing grounded-understanding may apply only to a separately performed qualifying probe that establishes genuinely new information; preparation or mastery does not qualify. Health, toxicity and hunger remain independent of pleasure.
reviews.visualReview: Show a short hand-mashing action only during paid work, a progress indicator and a visibly distinct prepared-food stack only after completion. Inspection and replay show real ingredients, portions, nutrient totals and spoilage state. No flames, vessel, cleanliness claim or safety icon unsupported by the actual process.
reviews.specification: Implement prepare-food@1 through the current development handoff. Public schema: {operation:'start'|'continue'|'cancel'|'inspect', processId?, inputs?:[{itemId,quantity}]}; start accepts owned root and/or berry totaling 1–4 units in 0.1-unit increments. Shared references: persistent actor/item/process IDs, world coordinates, dt=1, interaction reach=0.65, actual ownership, energy, death and inventory-capacity checks. Require individual mastery, a living actor, valid unspoiled edible inputs and sufficient energy. No equipment prerequisite for this cold hand-mashing method; it does not wash, sterilize, cook or remove toxins. Work is ceil(total input mass/0.4) rounds, minimum 1, costing 1 energy per completed work round. At start transfer identified quantities into actor-owned process escrow; retain source IDs, quantities, harvest times, decay and full composition. Record initialWork, completedWork, remainingWork, paidEnergy and status. Each explicit continue performs at most one round while alive; no automatic future actions. At completion transform escrow exactly once into one divisible hand-mashed-food stack of equal mass, summed actual remaining nutrition and toxicity, ingredient-proportional composition and unchanged effective spoilage deadline. Register the output as consumable by eat using proportional nutrition/toxicity and ordinary intake costs; portions cannot duplicate nutrients or count the same ingredient twice for dietary diversity. Preparation grants no preservation or healing. Pause if energy or inventory capacity is insufficient; escrow continues aging. Cancel, including death cancellation, returns all untransformed escrow once to the actor's inventory if alive and capacity permits, otherwise to an actual ground stack at the process position; never clone, erase or refund paid work. No solid structure is created; the process remains with the actor and occupies no extra collision area. Completion must fit carrying limits or wait until it can be placed within reach on valid ground. Expose progress, remaining labor, composition, food safety, expiry and output IDs in inspect and personal records. Declare and bind process-progress, process-completed, process-stopped and existing ate/meal-experience events to authoritative state changes. Render preparation activity and the actual output stack, with replay records of inputs, energy spent, progress, cancellation and consumed portions. Reuse inventory, spoilage, eat and meal-experience code separately from this new preparation function. Migrate by adding versioned process/output schemas and a provenance-aware edible adapter; existing food and meal records remain valid. Implementation and study create no food or elapsed simulation time.

reviews.reason: No registered capability constructs weather protection or changes exposure at a resting location. A small lashed branch frame with overlapping bark covering is a feasible minimal shelter. Materials and a suitable site must be obtained and validated in actual state; nearby branches alone are not a completed shelter or proof that all inputs are available.
reviews.experienceReview: Physical protection is conditional: current temperature alone does not establish discomfort, and shelter does not directly supply happiness, nutrition or healing. Add one deduplicated weather-refuge experience source subscribed to sheltered-rest. Participants are only actors who independently completed rest within the roof footprint, alive throughout that round. Qualify when actual rain or wind was at least 0.2, roof integrity was positive, calculated exposure was reduced by at least 25%, and the actor's fatigue or thermal discomfort measurably improved without acute injury during the round. Temporary pleasure is 0.3, capped at 0.6 across this functional source, held for 4 rounds; qualifying repetitions refresh only, with an 8-round cooldown per actor. Separately, maintained refuge satisfaction gains 0.015 per qualifying rested round, at most once per actor per round, saturating at 0.4 and decaying by 0.003 each round without qualifying participation. This represents repeated experienced relief rather than ownership or construction achievement; aliases and multiple shelters share the same caps. Neither applications, work completion, learning nor another actor's use qualifies. Keep protected mental accounts and physical survival calculations unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Render paid construction stages, actual posts, sloping overlapping bark roof, clear entrance and traversable interior using the same geometry as collision and exposure tests. Show damage and missing cover as integrity declines. Occupancy, rain interception and measured exposure may be overlaid in inspection; replay must show material transfers, labor, repairs and actual sheltered rest, not an unearned shelter or occupants acting without their own actions.
reviews.specification: Implement weather-lean-to@1 through the current development handoff, including its physical shelter mechanism. Public schema: {operation:'start'|'work'|'cancel'|'inspect'|'repair'|'dismantle', processId?, shelterId?, site?:{x,y,angle}, materials?:[{itemId,quantity}]}. Shared references: persistent actor/item/process/object IDs, world coordinates, dt=1, interaction reach=0.65, shared collision/occupancy queries and current weather. Require individual mastery and actual owned materials: 4 branch units for the frame, 2 vine units for lashings and 6 bark units for overlapping cover; gather remains a separate existing operation and supplies no stock by declaration. Start requires dry, stable ground and a clear 2-by-2-meter footprint, with a 0.8-meter entrance corridor; reject overlaps with solid objects, living occupants, reserved worksites and blocked access. Use an oriented footprint centered on site; two rear corners and one side support define solid 0.1-meter-radius posts, while the roof is overhead and the designated interior remains traversable. Shelter protection applies only to an actor whose full body footprint is beneath the roof, never merely near the object. Start escrows exact materials with owner and provenance and reserves the footprint. Construction takes 8 explicit adjacent work rounds at 2 energy each, with recorded completedWork/remainingWork and no passive progress. Until completed, it provides no shelter protection. Insufficient energy or blocked access pauses work; escrow and reservations persist. On cancellation or death, release reservations and return every untransformed escrow item once to valid ground at the site, retaining ownership/provenance; spent labor is not refunded. Completion consumes escrow exactly once into persistent recoverable material components and creates the shelter, not inventory stock. Persist roof coverage, orientation, integrity=1, weather exposure history and component provenance. Each occupied or unoccupied round reduces integrity by 0.0005 plus 0.002 times normalized rain plus 0.002 times normalized wind, clamped at zero. Effective rain exposure beneath intact cover is multiplied by 1-0.8*integrity and wind exposure by 1-0.6*integrity; feed these actual local values into wetness, heat-loss and temperature updates. If wetness is absent, implement bounded wetness [0,1], rising 0.05*localRain per round and drying 0.02*(1-localRain), with wetness multiplying environmental heat loss by 1+0.5*wetness. Use the same physical model outdoors; do not rewrite current temperature or award health. No fire, active heating, ground insulation, flood immunity or guaranteed comfort is supplied. Rest uses the existing recovery mechanism with any weather-dependent modifier computed from actual exposure and fatigue, never a separate free recovery grant. At integrity zero protection ceases. Repair uses 1 bark and 0.5 vine, 2 work rounds at 2 energy each, restoring at most 0.25 integrity on completion; escrow/cancellation rules match construction. Dismantle takes 2 rounds at 1 energy each and converts recorded components to ground materials scaled by integrity, with unrecovered mass recorded as unusable debris, never duplicated. All operations cancel on death while preserving installed components and remaining escrow. Declare process-progress, process-completed, process-stopped, shelter-exposure and sheltered-rest events; bind them to work, actual environmental updates and completed rest respectively. Inspect exposes geometry, access, material ledger, work remaining, integrity and measured exposure reduction. Add versioned shelter/process state, shared geometry queries, physical update bindings, rest integration and rendering/replay adapters; migrate existing actors through ordinary environmental updates without retroactive benefit. No shelter, stock, study or simulation time is granted during implementation.
